FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 188
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/01/2023
House Bill 188 as introduced would prohibit state and local governments from considering
environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria or rating in the awarding of public
contracts over $100,000. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
